profile:
COMPANY NAME: Energy Focus Inc.
INDUSTRY: Renewable Energy & LED Lighting Technology
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: Advanced LED lighting systems, solar technology, and comprehensive energy storage solutions (including home, commercial, and industrial storage, solar inverters, and power supplies).
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Military & Government facilities, commercial and industrial sectors, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and residential homeowners.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise / B2B
KEY FEATURES:
*   High-efficiency LED lighting and solar technology
*   Turnkey energy storage systems (BESS, PCS, Inverters)
*   IoT connectivity and smart energy-saving systems
*   Advanced automation technologies for manufacturing
*   Rigorous quality control and military-grade durability
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: Proven track record with the U.S. Navy (lighting ships and submarines), status as a publicly traded company with over two decades of history, and a global presence that ensures competitiveness and supply chain resilience.
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Industrial / Sustainable
